description: Hydrants is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. View full metadata Description Fire Hydrants are maintained by the Engineering group at the Cambridge Water Department, Hydrants are also monitored by Cambridge Fire Department. Used for public safety, mapping, and water distribution. About Edit Dates This data is automatically updated on a set schedule. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Water Department. Its tags are gis, health and safety, glocal, fire department, water. The table has 25 columns. Attribution on the portal: Cambridge GIS. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
